get.summary: The person's Client APIs (client credentials), newest first. Never a secret.

post.summary: Creates a Client API and answers its secret once: only its hash is kept.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the person's Client APIs; its tokens stop working at once.

get.summary: The banks of a country the bank plugin can connect.

post.summary: Starts the access to a bank: the answer is the bank's page.

get.summary: The person's categories in tree order, with how many movements each has.

post.summary: Creates a category or a group.

delete.summary: Deletes a category for good, and at the source it came from. `external` says what the source did.

patch.summary: Changes a category's name, group or colour.

post.summary: Archives a category, with the sub-categories of a group. `ids` is what «Undo» restores.

get.summary: What moving a group to another macro changes, before the move: movements, total, linked records.

post.summary: Moves a group, or a category of Transfers, to another macro. The numbers change; `undo` takes it back.
Moves a category to another group of the same macro. `fromId` is the group it left.
Undoes a move to another macro with the `undo` the move answered.
Merges two categories: movements, sub-categories and budget limits of `dropId` go to `keepId`.
Undoes a merge with the `undo` the merge answered.
Brings archived categories back: one, or every one an archive put away.

get.summary: The apps the person gave consent to, oldest first: the devices of the apps among them.

delete.summary: Takes a consent back: the app's refresh tokens go, and its next sign-in asks again.

get.summary: The person's connections with their state, schedule, capabilities and last runs.

post.summary: Connects a provider that takes credentials. The fields of `credentials` are the ones the provider's descriptor names.

delete.summary: Disconnects: the credentials go, the accounts and movements stay. Also cancels a bank connection not finished.

get.summary: The accounts the provider exposes now, and which of them the person chose.

put.summary: Chooses the accounts of a connection: a new account, an account here, or left out.

post.summary: «Turn on» the plugin of the connection; each of its connections is read at once.
Reads the history again, `months` back: one of `capabilities.historyMonths`.
Tries the first reading of a bank again, now, after a refusal.
Renews the access to a bank before or after it ends: the answer is the bank's page.
«Turn on again»: the provider's recommended schedule.

put.summary: Saves when the connection is read: times in the person's zone. No rule is «only by hand».

post.summary: The next passes of a schedule not saved yet, in the person's zone, and what is wrong with it. Saves nothing.
«Update now»: a reading in the worker's queue. The answer does not wait; the run is in `runs`.
Tries the saved credentials against the provider and records the verdict.

get.summary: The person's labels, with how many movements carry each.

post.summary: Creates a label.

delete.summary: Deletes a label; the movements keep everything else.

patch.summary: Changes a label's name or colour.

get.summary: The version of the instance, the level of its API and what it can do.
Everyone who can reach the instance: the users, then the invitations still outstanding.

delete.summary: Deletes a person and everything they own. The last admin and the admin who asks are refused.

patch.summary: Changes a person's role or blocks them. The last admin and the admin who asks are refused.

post.summary: Emails a person a link to choose a new password.

delete.summary: Turns a person's two-factor sign-in off, for a lost device.

post.summary: Invites a person by email. `outcome` says whether the email left, or why it did not.

delete.summary: Withdraws an invitation: its link stops working.

patch.summary: Turns a plugin on or off for the person.

delete.summary: Removes the credentials of a plugin's application.

put.summary: Checks and saves the credentials of a plugin's application. The key never comes back.

get.summary: The person's preferences: language, zone, number format, display currency, theme, time off.

patch.summary: Changes some preferences; a field left out keeps its value. A new zone moves the sync times with it.

get.summary: Who the token acts for: name, email, role, and whether the identity provider manages them.

patch.summary: Changes the person's name. Refused with `conflict` (`reason: sso`) when the provider manages it.

post.summary: Makes a backup of the database now and answers its size in bytes.

get.summary: Every job of the worker with its last run.

post.summary: Puts one job in the worker's queue. The answer does not wait: the run is in `GET /server/jobs`.

delete.summary: Removes the AI service and its key.

put.summary: Saves the AI service that reads a document when its reader cannot. An empty key keeps the saved one.

post.summary: Tries the saved key and model. Saves nothing; the service's answer is never quoted.

delete.summary: Removes the saved provider: the values of the environment apply again.

put.summary: Saves the sign-in provider. A new issuer signs everyone out (`signedEveryoneOut`).

post.summary: Reads the discovery document of the saved provider and records the verdict.

get.summary: The AI service, the sign-in provider, the mail transport and the maintenance facts. No secret.

delete.summary: Removes the saved transport: the values of the environment apply again.

put.summary: Saves the mail transport and which emails go out. An empty password keeps the saved one.

post.summary: Sends one email to the admin who asked, through the transport as it is saved.

get.summary: The person's open sign-ins on the web, newest first. Never a session token.

delete.summary: Signs one session out. A session that is not the person's answers as one already gone.

get.summary: Every category the person's sources bring, and where its movements count here.

put.summary: Sets where a source's category counts: a category of the person, or its own (`null`).

post.summary: «Keep as it is» on a new category of a source: it stays added and is no longer new.
Undoes a change of where a source's category counts.
Brings back an account deleted here: the source may bring it again. A bank's account is chosen again on `reconnect`.
Turns a source off after a last reading: its accounts are kept by hand from now.

get.summary: What turning a source off changes, before it is turned off.
